capabilities: Add emoji icons to internal attachment links in Reading view
Customize built-in types' icons, names, and extension lists
Create custom file types with their own icons and extensions
Restrict types to specific folders and reorder matching priority
Place icons before or after the link text
disambiguation: It only adds icons to regular internal links; it does not touch embeds like ![[photo.jpg]], whose preview already shows the file type.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.8.7 or later; settings page follows the app language (Korean or English); icon appears only in rendered links, never in the source Markdown.
motivation: The README says friendly display names keep notes tidy but hide the file type, so the author wanted visual context while preserving clean link text.
problem: Friendly display names on attachment links hide whether the target is an image, PDF, or spreadsheet, so you can't tell the file type at a glance.
summary: Renders configurable file-type emoji icons on internal links to attachments in Reading view without altering the Markdown.
